title: Training validation and save recovery
summary: Explore required-field validation, one scoped save failure, retained editable content, and the documented retry path.
allowedActions: Reset the declared owned fixture and verify the selected target/build/connector
Open a new training plan and submit the documented invalid or incomplete state
Enter the canonical fixture values and arm only the declared account-scoped one-time fault
Submit Save once, inspect retained inputs and error feedback, clear the declared fault, and retry once
Verify the final durable state with the authenticated API and read-only SQL evidence
excludedExternalEffects: Unscoped network interception, production writes, real purchases, or provider-console changes
Direct database writes that perform the save under test or mutation of unrelated users/plans
Repeated retries after two unchanged failures, selector healing, coordinate actions, or hidden bypass flags
Classifying a validation or harness block as a product bug without the authoritative expectation

scenario.title: Validation and one failed Save retain an editable draft for one retry
preconditions: The fixture has a fresh professional draft and a once-only private fault scoped to that attempt
The expected invalid state and the expected saved values are taken from the cited documents
The API and SQL read identities are independent of the UI action path
actions: Submit an incomplete plan and observe validation
Complete the draft, trigger one declared save failure, and capture the first anomaly
Inspect the retained form values and error state
Clear the fault, retry once, and verify one durable result through API and SQL
expectedObservations: Invalid input blocks Save and exposes the documented localized guidance
A failed Save retains the editable draft and does not create a durable row
The cleared fault permits one normal retry without duplicate data
The finding classification separates product behavior from selector, fixture, and harness failures
